notes.title: March 2025 Update - Trailer & Modes Overview!
notes.content:
Hello Survivors!

[img]https://clan.fastly.steamstatic.com/images/33023292/59770769ab289361111794199201d10bb4b9bd4b.png[/img]

First, check out this new trailer: 

https://youtu.be/vtxiPu7Cr8Q

Today, we're going to break down the game's modes and hub area for you!  The entirety of [b]Outbreak: Shades of Horror[/b] can be experienced either solo or with up to three friends in co-op play over the network.

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1932190/Outbreak_Shades_of_Horror/

[b]Cypress Reel
[/b]

[img]https://clan.fastly.steamstatic.com/images/33023292/9677a909a75b28e637ceb34b3a4f178b0716e163.png[/img]

This playground is where you and your friends can group up and enter the game's various modes!  You can select your character (across over 25 options!) and practice your controls, and you can also test your mettle at the obstacle course, improve your combat prowess, check out the game's various abilities and items, and so much more!  Over time, Cypress Reel will expand with new content and special events!

[b]Story mode
[/b]

[img]https://clan.fastly.steamstatic.com/images/33023292/8512ba1729ba7b2e84ea19f68d7346be4a2cc8b3.jpg[/img]

This is the survival horror campaign you're all expecting!  Manage your resources and inventory, defeat menacing zombies, solve puzzles, and find notes as you explore colossal maps with awesome set-pieces and challenging encounters.  Each episode will play out in explosive fashion, with multiple routes and many secrets to discover.

[b]Invasion mode
[/b]

[img]https://clan.fastly.steamstatic.com/images/33023292/2170722194b67491d86f8398c70ef68f36ced3bf.jpg[/img]

A different flavor of survival.  You'll face down endless enemy hordes as you attempt to both live and protect innocents.  Before the game begins, you have a small period of time to fortify your base with turrets, traps, and more.  Once the creatures appear, you'll need to annihilate hundreds of them without losing all of your lives or your civilians in the heat of battle.  Multiple maps will be available!

[b]Raid mode
[/b]

This arcade-style experience is a blast.  Scout sprawling, tight maps, take on the undead masses, and rescue trapped civilians before time runs out!  As with the rest of [b]Outbreak: Shades of Horror[/b], Raid mode will be updated with new content and maps over time.  Fans of our previous games may even find some fun nods to our history.

[b]Mini-games
[/b]

[img]https://clan.fastly.steamstatic.com/images/33023292/7d7475934f99c250afa98975b54c30484bbe6e13.jpg[/img]

For some quick action, check out a selection of extra game types inspired by classic survival horror masterpieces.  From Boss Rush, where you'll face a parade of tough monsters, to Collapse, where you'll flee a nasty subway on the brink of destruction, these scenarios are fun to play through over and over.  Look forward to new mini-games as the game continues to grow!

We hope you're excited to experience the wild world of Cypress Ridge when [b]Outbreak: Shades of Horror[/b] begins its descent onto Xbox Series, PlayStation 5, and on PC via Steam this year!  We will of course continue to update you with the latest information and more specific release timing as development continues.  Thank you as always for your support and patience.

notes.title: [Chromatic Split] Quick Note Regarding Keyboard & Mouse Controls
notes.content:
Hi Survivors!

We've gotten a few questions regarding Keyboard & Mouse controls for the game.

[b]KBM support is always active and can be used at any time on top of our gamepad support.[/b]

If you'd like to see on-screen controls for your control scheme of choice:

Go to [b]Settings[/b] -> [b]Game Settings[/b] -> [b]Controller Icons[/b]

You can set Controller Icons to Xbox, PlayStation, Keyboard, or Hidden.

We also wanted to inform you that an incoming patch will fix the icon sizes for the on-screen KBM control display.  In the near future, we will also support key rebinding.

Thank you for reading, and we hope you enjoy the game!

notes.title: Chromatic Split is AVAILABLE NOW on Steam!
notes.content:
Hello Survivors!  Just a quick note today!

After a small delay, we are excited to share that the Steam version of [i]Outbreak: Shades of Horror Chromatic Split[/i] is now available to play and purchase with a 20% launch discount!

Thank you all so much for your patience!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/3107090/Outbreak_Shades_of_Horror_Chromatic_Split

[i]Chromatic Split[/i] is a standalone prologue to the upcoming [i]Outbreak: Shades of Horror[/i] starring our hero Lydia Daniels.  Our detective enters the Cypress Ridge sewer system to meet with her contact on the eve of a massive zombie outbreak, and things quickly devolve from there.

Though initially unarmed, you will eventually find a melee weapon and firearms that allow you to progress through sprawling maps.  Items and resources are limited, so what you use them to craft, be it healing items, ammo, or save items, will be key to your survival.  Enemies can be strategically dismembered to make the most of your limited ammo, while massive boss creatures will require a lot more tenacity to finish off.

Explore the Cypress Ridge underground across a three act campaign, and then enjoy a variety of bonus modes and new game plus once you complete the game!  Post launch content will include additional bonus modes and the Trials of Hank, an extra side-campaign.

Gory survival horror gameplay meets glamorous graphics only possible with Unreal Engine 5 in [i]Outbreak: Shades of Horror Chromatic Split[/i], available now!

notes.title: Visual Novel 'What Lydia Knows' Launches FRIDAY May 3rd!
notes.content:
[img]https://clan.cloudflare.steamstatic.com/images/33023292/3a0206c53c19290a6b1538592fe9d1c561111128.png[/img]

Hello Survivors!

Get ready for a double-dose of adventure [b]this Friday, May 3rd[/b], when [i]Outbreak The FEDORA Files: What Lydia Knows[/i] launches on Steam, Nintendo Switch, PlayStation 5, PlayStation 4, and Epic Games Store!

[b]Enjoy a 25% off launch discount here on Steam![/b]

This two game pack includes the following:

[i]FEDORA Files: What Lydia Knows[/i]

In our first file of “[i]The FEDORA Files[/i]” three part limited series: What Lydia Knows, play as intrepid detective Lydia Daniels as she tries to discover the mystery behind her partner's disappearance. Search for clues, probe allies and enemies, and solve the mystery of the Jackson Street Sewers in this installment that acts a prequel to [i]Outbreak: Shades of Horror.[/i]

Features:
[list]
[*]Narrative rich visual novel with a deep and engrossing storyline.
[*]Multiple paths and endings to unlock where your choices matter.
[*]Meet, befriend, or alienate a wide cast of characters where your relationships matter.
[*]Solve devious puzzles and navigate crazy minigames as you hunt for the truth.
[/list]

[i]Outbreak RPG
[/i]
In the aftermath of the Outbreak, play a group of survivors out to rescue their compatriots in Outbreak RPG! A Semi procedurally generated rogue-like RPG, every boot up is a new adventure. Rescued survivors will bring new skills and challenges with them. Can you survive the Outbreak?!

Features:
[list]
[*]Semi procedurally generated rogue-like RPG
[*]Lead your party of four survivors through the apocalypse in turn-based combat
[*]Search for supplies to keep yourself armed and healthy
[*]Rescue a wide group of survivors, each of which joins your team with unique upgrades and abilities
[*]Challenging escalating enemy encounters as the city becomes further overrun with the undead
[*]Hilarious and ridiculous dialogue in this non-canon adventure
[/list]

notes.title: Railbreak Update 5 is now available. Massive performance and graphics improvemen
notes.content:
Railbreak Update 5 has been released with the following fixes on Steam.

[list]
[*] Massive performance improvements for all hardware to remove remaining stutter, reduce overhead of having many enemies on screen, remove strange slowdown when the Kunoichi is on screen, and especially remove stutter during explosions or chaotic scenes.
[*] DLSS 3.5 w/ Frame Generation is fully supported for compatible cards.
[*] Screen percentage setting now behaves correctly on all hardware.
[*] Player hair for all characters both looks better and has better performance.
[*] Bounding boxes remaining after some enemy types have died have been fixed.
[*] Minor balancing and other fixes across the game.
[*] The dinosaurs are taking a break but Korrine can still see the future. Can you find them all?
[/list]

notes.title: 'What Lydia Knows' Visual Novel Bonus Game Revealed: 'Outbreak RPG'!
notes.content:
Hello Survivors!  Today, we're excited to bring you the first of a few major announcements this week.

﻿[img]https://clan.akamai.steamstatic.com/images/33023292/c5d6baafc3e5894b17fddde657cd5c5f02e238e0.png[/img]

If you watched [url=http://www.twitch.tv/deaddropstudios]our Twitch stream[/url] tonight, then you'll see we've officially revealed the bonus game included with [b]Outbreak The FEDORA Files: What Lydia Knows[/b]!

﻿[img]https://clan.akamai.steamstatic.com/images/33023292/091cb36b401b1dfbae1d5104013328de1725b09e.jpg[/img]

We're thrilled for you to get your hands on the highly fan-requested [b]Outbreak RPG[/b]! This fully featured bonus game is available immediately when you boot up [b]What Lydia Knows[/b], and the adventure changes every time you play.

Guide your party of Lydia, Hank, Ivy, and Elena through Cypress Ridge as they try to help Survivors and escape the city.  Fight monsters in classic turn-based combat as you search for supplies and any signs of human life.  Level up and upgrade your characters' weapons to defeat hordes of zombies.  The Survivors you rescue will provide your party with unique perks and enhancements that you'll need to take full advantage of if you want to escape Cypress Ridge alive!

You can check out our new trailer for [b]Outbreak The FEDORA Files: What Lydia Knows[/b] that we debuted today to whet your appetite before the game launches!  We'll be sharing the games release date and platforms soon.

https://youtu.be/ZKbEM4OOa5U

There are even more features and bonuses included in [b]Outbreak The FEDORA Files: What Lydia Knows[/b] that we have yet to reveal, so we hope you'll be excited for more information in the future.

You can wishlist the game on [b]Steam[/b] NOW so you can be notified when it drops!  Wishlisting the game also helps us out quite a lot, so please consider telling a friend about it!  We greatly appreciate any and all of your support.

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2587130/Outbreak_The_Fedora_Files_What_Lydia_Knows/

notes.title: Railbreak Content Update One - Time Korrisis - Available Now!
notes.content:
[previewyoutube=Qr1tBwmlCBQ;full][/previewyoutube]

Railbreak Content Update One (Patch 4) is LIVE NOW and features the following:
- Korrine, the GlitchGoddess, is now available when selecting a character outside of Story Mode.
- She uses special projectile attacks which are different than other characters.
- Korrine's Plasma Cannon (Primary) consumes huge amounts of rifle rounds, but deals extreme damage over a large radius.
- Her sidearm randomly alternates between elemental attacks and will randomly dismember different parts of enemies.
The Katana has the ability to trigger Korrine's Blessing, a super glitch that boosts scoring and damage, but also costs a terrible price as it'll force the player to endure a significant debuff.
- As the Glitch Goddess, Korrine can also see into the future, so you may notice.... differences.... compared to other characters as you play the game. We assure you these changes are only visual, they probably can't hurt you, and only Korrine can see them.
- The Time Korrisis Scoring Mode has been added to the game. Time Korrisis is a new way to play all of the content in Railbreak by turning the game into a Time Attack arcade game.
- In Time Korrisis Mode, you will earn time by damaging and killing enemies, picking up weapons, and more. Headshots and limb shots award extra time.
- If your timer runs out, you'll be instantly killed and will need to spend a life to continue.
This mode tracks your score separately across the game. More time remaining at the end of a level will yield a better rank. Good luck!
- The character screen now clearly explains elemental damage and other traits.
- Significant bug fixes, balancing changes, and graphics improvements across the game.

notes.title: Railbreak Patch 3 is now available on Steam!
notes.content:
[img]https://clan.cloudflare.steamstatic.com/images/33023292/84af881a4de8ca531fad3bc7918e0214d96de8c4.jpg[/img]

Hey Survivors,

Our latest patch for Railbreak is now live on Steam! This patch brings some meaty graphical enhancements to the game, and brings the title up to the 12GB size that was advertised on the store page since launch. If you encounter any instability, just reduce the Texture Quality setting in the Video Settings menu as that area received the biggest upgrade across the game.

[h1]Patch 3[/h1]
- Significant graphics improvements across the entire game. Hard drive space usage increased, however run-time RAM usage only appears slightly higher in-game as per our testing. This change does not affect the game's framerate.
- Fixed an issue where the Sinden Lightgun Border would disappear on the Game Over screen.

notes.title: Railbreak Patch 2 is now available on Steam!
notes.content:
[img]https://clan.cloudflare.steamstatic.com/images/33023292/1ad558ba52773cb53b86bf159aa488a7e6dce9af.jpg[/img]

Hey Survivors!

Good news! A few more glitches have been patched in the world of Railbreak on Steam! These patches are rolling out to all other platforms today as well!

Here's what we did, and don't forget to check the "Update Notes" button on the title screen for this complete list too! We have plenty more updates coming in the weeks ahead!

[h1]Patch 2[/h1]
- Added a "Compile Shaders" button to the Settings menu.
- Added the Update Notes screen.
- High scores now properly save in all parts of the game.
- Added an option in Audio Settings to allow you to set the character's voice volume level independently.
- Fixed numerous infrequent softlocks on Acts 2, 4, 5, and 6.
- Added an option in Game Settings to allow you to specify additional wait time before moving to another area to make it easier to collect items.
- Added an option to the Screen Filter Override in the Game Settings menu called "Never Switch", which will ensure no game overlays ever appear on screen.
- Added an option to the Game Settings to specify larger bounding boxes on item pickups. This can only be set at the Main Menu.
- Items can now only be picked up if they're visible to the player, and cannot be collected through walls or other surfaces anymore.
- Improvements to eliminate a very infrequent situation where being grabbed by a zombie would remove your gun.
- Additional performance improvements across the title.
- Item highlights now appear at greater range.

notes.title: Chunky New Modes and Features for Railbreak! Launch Trailer Live! New Gameplay Stream Tonight!
notes.content:
Hello again Survivors!

[img]https://clan.cloudflare.steamstatic.com/images/33023292/1be883981fb083180c6f4fefe5e192b73d85b097.png[/img]

https://youtu.be/y-WS-KRfjDM

Today we're excited to announce a slew of new features for our upcoming arcade on-rails shooter, [i]Railbreak[/i]!  As previously mentioned, [i]Railbreak[/i] will be launching on Xbox Series X|S, PlayStation 5, Steam, and Epic Games Store on December 22nd at a price of $19.99 USD worldwide!

Since we last showed off the game, [i]Railbreak[/i] has evolved in several really important ways.  The work on the game has also enhanced the map design and general gameplay for [i]Outbreak: Shades of Horror[/i], as well. Stay tuned for more information on [i]Outbreak: Shades of Horror[/i] in the future!

We have FOUR key categories to touch on today!

[b]1. New Elemental Weapons[/b]

If you tuned into our last stream, you may know a bit about these already!  The primary and secondary weapons in [i]Railbreak[/i] are outfitted with unique [b]elemental effects[/b] that can give you an advantage in battle.  Load up enemies with [b]electricity[/b] and watch them explode! Stop zombies in their tracks with [b]ice[/b] ammo! Melt through the undead with [b]fire[/b]! Send the body parts flying with [b]explosive rounds[/b]! The new elemental effects drive the action into absolutely chaotic territory, so be sure to take advantage of your arsenal!

[b]2. 'Glitch' Gameplay Modifier System[/b]

As you progress through the game, things may become a little dicey when new modifiers dubbed 'Glitches' trigger during a stage.  Some Glitches may lend a helping hand with [b]infinite ammo[/b] or a [b]defensive buff[/b], while others may serve as a thorn in your side with [b]enemies gaining additional health[/b] or a [b]storm of civilians[/b] running out in front of your shots. With a ton of different Glitches to encounter, you'll need to stay on your toes to survive!

[b]3. New Special Boss Zombies[/b]

On top of your run-of-the-mill zombies, keep your eyes out for powerful boss monsters! [b]Boom Boom[/b] will detonate itself if you're unable to kill it fast enough! The demonic [b]Fetch[/b] will blast and blind you with its powerful laser attack!  Things get even hairier when you encounter 'Glitched' versions of these beasts; these enhanced versions of the special infected have are faster, stronger, and tankier! 

[b]4. Three New Bonus Modes[/b]

Thought you knew all the ways you'd play [i]Railbreak[/i]? Think again! Deal with constantly firing and random Glitch modifiers in [b]Glitch Gauntlet[/b]! Face off against all of the game's bosses in a unique scenario in [b]Boss Rush[/b]! Face a special challenge that serves to thank our supporters in [b]Shoutout Shootout[/b]! With these new modes, you'll never run out of ways to play [i]Railbreak[/i] either alone or with a friend in optional two-player coop!

As the December 22nd release date for [i]Railbreak[/i] creeps ever closer, we're getting more and more excited for you to see our take on the on-rails arcade shooter genre!  Join us [b]tonight, December 13th[/b] [url=http://www.twitch.tv/deaddropstudios]on our Twitch channel[/url] at [b]7PM EST[/b] for a special stream showing off some of these new features! We'll also be playing through some of the retro games that have inspired [i]Railbreak[/i], so be sure to tune in!  [b]If you hang out with us, you might even win a giveaway![/b]

[b]You can tune in here:[/b] [url=http://www.twitch.tv/deaddropstudios]http://www.twitch.tv/deaddropstudios[/url]

That's all for today, Survivors! Take care out there as we approach the Holidays, and thank you as always for your continued support!

notes.title: Introducing Railbreak! Special DINOBREAK Steam Tonight With Giveaway!
notes.content:
[img]https://clan.cloudflare.steamstatic.com/images/33023292/1371e83632ac19c701ef0f8f827221a13b05b964.png[/img]

Today we're announcing [b]Railbreak[/b], a new on-rails arcade shooter that takes place in the world of [b]Outbreak: Shades of Horror[/b].

View the trailer here: [url=https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=4uDtY1klUnM]https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=4uDtY1klUnM[/url]

Development of [b]Railbreak[/b] has taken place alongside [b]Shades of Horror[/b], with each game helping and enhancing the other!  [b]Railbreak[/b] started as a way to test and build out the co-op functionality in [b]Shades of Horror[/b], and it was so fun that we had to create a full featured experience out of it!

Featuring areas and content from the first act of [b]Shades of Horror[/b], [b]Railbreak[/b] is the ultimate sneak peek into how development on [b]SOH[/b] is progressing.

If you are an on-rails arcade game fan, you will be as thrilled as we are that the [b]Railbreak[/b] features optional support for [url=http://www.sindenlightgun.com][b]Sinden Lightguns[/b][/url] (Keep your peepers open for a bundle, people!!).  The game is fully playable in both single player and optional two player co-op with gamepad, mouse, and lightgun!

You can now check out [b]Railbreak[/b]'s [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2587170/Railbreak/?beta=0]Steam store page[/url] and [url=https://store.epicgames.com/en-US/p/railbreak-f87a0c]Epic Games Store page[/url]! Please consider [b]wishlisting[/b] the game as it helps us out a lot!  Stay tuned for more details as [b]Railbreak[/b] approaches its [b]Winter[/b] release!

[img]https://clan.cloudflare.steamstatic.com/images/33023292/40688c3ed287e069fa8c4b0ac664afeb4766c48b.png[/img]

Meanwhile, [b]DINOBREAK[/b] has met with a wonderful reception since its launch last week. Thank you to everyone who has bought and played the game!

If you enjoyed the game, please consider leaving us a positive review! It really does help us out a lot!

If you haven't yet purchased [b]DINOBREAK[/b], you can find it on most current platforms at an MSRP of $19.99 USD (worldwide pricing may vary). We built this game as a spiritual successor to classic survival horror game [b]Dino Crisis[/b], and we're thrilled with how it's turned out!

You can check out [b]DINOBREAK[/b] here:
